map.有效载荷占比为什么通常很小？: Why is the payload fraction usually so small?
map.火箭绝大部分质量是燃料与结构，入轨要克服巨大 Δv，按齐奥尔科夫斯基公式，载荷占: Most of a rocket's mass is propellant and structure, and reaching orbit means overcoming a huge delta-v, so by the Tsiolkovsky equation the payload fraction grows exponentially with the mass ratio, making multiple stages, light structures and high specific impulse all indispensable. 1%-4% is a common order of magnitude.
map.结构比和载荷占比区别？: What is the difference between the structural ratio and the payload fraction?
map.结构比 m_f/m₀ 是末质量占初质量比例（含载荷+上面级残骸）；载荷占比专指有: The structural ratio m_f/m_0 is the final mass as a share of the initial mass (payload plus upper-stage debris); the payload fraction refers only to payload over total initial mass and more directly measures "cargo efficiency". Both share the denominator and differ in the numerator.
